Datum Dahleez Eyewear enters a new Era of design guided by a philosophy of timelessness and quiet luxury. Ultra-thin, flexible titanium temples complete the structure, resulting in eyewear that feels remarkably light while offering strength, durability and personalized comfort across a diverse range of face shapes.
